gloss: carving chisel; woodcarving knife; engraving tool

definitions.gloss: carving chisel; woodcarving knife; engraving tool
definitions.explanation: A hand tool with a sharp blade used for carving or engraving wood, linoleum, or other materials.

examples.japanese: {彫刻刀|ちょうこくとう}で{木|き}を{彫|ほ}る。
examples.english: To carve wood with a chisel.

examples.japanese: {小学校|しょうがっこう}の{図工|ずこう}の{時間|じかん}に{彫刻刀|ちょうこくとう}を{使|つか}った。
examples.english: I used carving chisels during arts and crafts class in elementary school.

examples.japanese: {彫刻刀|ちょうこくとう}の{刃|は}が{欠|か}けたので{新|あたら}しいものを{買|か}いに{行|い}った。
examples.english: The blade on my carving chisel chipped, so I went to buy a new one.

notes:
In Japanese schools, students typically use a set of {彫刻刀|ちょうこくとう} during art class ({図工|ずこう}) for woodblock printing ({版画|はんが}). Standard school sets include several blade types such as {丸刀|まるとう} (round gouge), {平刀|ひらとう} (flat chisel), {三角刀|さんかくとう} (V-gouge), and {切出|きりだ}し{刀|とう} (cutting knife).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {彫刻刀|ちょうこくとう}で{彫|ほ}る — to carve with a chisel
- {彫刻刀|ちょうこくとう}セット — carving chisel set
- {彫刻刀|ちょうこくとう}の{刃|は} — chisel blade
- {彫刻刀|ちょうこくとう}を{研|と}ぐ — to sharpen a chisel

RELATED TERMS:
- {彫刻|ちょうこく} — sculpture; carving
- {版画|はんが} — woodblock print
- {のみ} — chisel (for larger woodworking)
